SELECT id, artist_name AS artistName, artist_cover AS artistCover, introduction, gender, country, album_count AS albumCount, song_count AS songCount, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM artist
AND artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) <= '9'
AND (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) > '9' AND UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1)) < 'A') OR UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1)) > 'Z' OR COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name) IS NULL)
AND COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name) LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
ORDER BY album_count DESC, artist_name
ORDER BY song_count DESC, artist_name
ORDER BY COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name)
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT LOWER(artist_name) AS "normName", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", LISTAGG(CAST(id AS VARCHAR), ',') AS "ids" FROM artist GROUP BY LOWER(artist_name) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY "cnt" DESC
SELECT LOWER(artist_name) AS normName, COUNT(*) AS cnt, GROUP_CONCAT(id SEPARATOR ',') AS ids FROM artist GROUP BY LOWER(artist_name) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC
